mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prd_member (id, prd_id, user_id, role, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{prdId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{createdBy}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id, m.role, u.username, u.display_name, u.email FROM prd_member m JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.prd_id = #{prdId} ORDER BY m.created_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM prd_member WHERE prd_id = #{prdId} AND user_id = #{userId}
